records.title: Q4 Strategy Sync
records.content: Reviewed Q4 objectives for Platform Design. Discussed customer insight priorities for year-end reporting and resource allocation for upcoming holiday code freeze.

records.title: 1:1 with Grace Lin
records.content: Career development discussion. Grace expressed interest in transitioning toward research operations. Identified specific training opportunities in participant management and tooling administration.

records.title: Customer Advisory Board Prep
records.content: Drafted discussion guide for December CAB session. Primary focus on mobile experience pain points in clinical settings. Malik provided external consultant perspective on healthcare workflows.

records.title: User Research Synthesis Workshop
records.content: Completed thematic analysis of twelve interviews with cardiology department staff. Key findings indicate significant friction in EHR integration points. Recommend prioritizing single-sign-on improvements in Q1.

records.title: Design System Accessibility Review
records.content: Reviewed component library with external accessibility consultant. Identified contrast issues in patient portal notification badges. Action items include updating color tokens and adding focus indicators.

records.title: End of Year Retrospective
records.content: Team celebrated 2023 wins including 40% reduction in research recruitment time. Identified process improvements needed for research participant consent flows, particularly for multi-site studies.

records.title: 2024 Roadmap Kickoff
records.content: Prioritized Q1 initiatives across Platform Design. Customer Insights team assigned lead on comprehensive provider experience audit. Calendared stakeholder interviews for January 22-26.

records.title: Vendor Evaluation: Research Platforms
records.content: Conducted cost-benefit analysis of UserTesting versus Maze for unmoderated testing. Recommendation to maintain current UserTesting contract for complex healthcare workflows while adding Maze license for rapid prototype validation.

records.title: Stakeholder Alignment: Marketing
records.content: Aligned with marketing team on messaging strategy for spring campaign. Shared recent survey insights indicating that time-saving features resonate most with clinic administrators. Adjusted value proposition framework accordingly.

records.title: Accessibility Audit Planning
records.content: Scheduled comprehensive WCAG 2.1 AA assessment for patient dashboard. Preparing inclusive research participant pool including users with motor impairments and screen reader dependency. Audit begins February 19.

records.title: 1:1 with Calvin Price
records.content: Quarterly check-in regarding team direction. Reviewed performance goals and discussed budget allocation for team members attending UX Healthcare conference in Nashville. Approved three conference passes.

records.title: Cross-functional Sync: Engineering
records.content: Shared findings on API usage patterns from recent shadowing sessions. Engineering team requesting more granular qualitative data on error recovery behaviors during patient data sync failures.

records.title: Healthcare UX Summit Planning
records.content: Finalizing workshop proposal submission on 'Research Ethics in Clinical Settings'. Owen contributing case studies from previous institutional review board negotiations. Submission deadline March 15.

records.title: Customer Interview: Dr. Sarah Chen
records.content: Shadowed oncologist using platform during morning rounds. Critical insight identified: urgent need for robust offline mode when accessing patient charts in basement imaging areas with poor connectivity.

records.title: Journey Mapping Session
records.content: Collaborative mapping of current state prescription refill workflow. Successfully identified three critical drop-off points between provider approval and pharmacy pickup. Prioritizing the prior authorization bottleneck.

records.title: Remote Research Tools Training
records.content: Team workshop on facilitating inclusive remote research sessions. Covered technical accessibility requirements, moderation techniques for participants with hearing impairments, and backup communication protocols.

records.title: Quarterly Business Review Prep
records.content: Drafted presentation deck on customer satisfaction trends for leadership team. Key metric: NPS improved eight points since Q4 2023, largely attributed to new onboarding flow launched in February.

records.title: Design Critique: Mobile App Navigation
records.content: Reviewed new navigation patterns for upcoming mobile release. Concerns raised regarding discoverability of lab results feature. Decision to implement progressive disclosure with contextual onboarding.

records.title: Privacy Compliance Check-in
records.content: Reviewed data retention policies for research interview recordings with legal team. Ensuring HIPAA compliance for proposed voice note feature. Approved 90-day retention with automatic anonymization.

records.title: User Testing: Voice Interface Pilot
records.content: Pilot test of voice-activated clinical charting with five participants. Command structure proved intuitive, but system struggled with medical terminology recognition. Recommend additional acoustic model training.

records.title: 1:1 with Leah Morgan
records.content: Career coaching session regarding potential transition to product management. Identified skill gaps in technical documentation and stakeholder management. Created six-month development plan.

records.title: Insights Dashboard Review
records.content: Automated reporting now successfully pulling from three distinct data sources. Need to validate metric calculations with data science team before rolling out to broader organization. Scheduled verification meeting.

records.title: Customer Advisory Board - June Session
records.content: Presented prototype of collaborative care features to CAB. Strong positive reception from rural clinic representatives regarding shared care plan functionality. Action items for interface refinements.

records.title: Research Ethics Board Presentation
records.content: Presented proposal for longitudinal study on medication adherence tracking. Institutional Review Board approved with minor revisions regarding consent form language. Study launch authorized for July.

records.title: Summer Intern Onboarding
records.content: Orientation session for design research intern joining through university partnership program. Assigned mentorship pairing with Grace Lin. Project focus: patient portal search functionality analysis.

records.title: Mid-Year Performance Review
records.content: Formal review with Calvin regarding annual goals progress. Exceeding expectations on stakeholder engagement and research quality. Development area identified: technical writing for engineering specifications.

records.title: Workshop: Advanced Synthesis Methods
records.content: External facilitator led immersive session on advanced affinity diagramming and thematic analysis. Applied techniques to recent telehealth study data, resulting in refined insight categories.

records.title: Vendor Demo: Research Repository Tools
records.content: Evaluated Dovetail for research repository and analysis. Promising transcription accuracy and highlight reel features, though concerns raised regarding Salesforce integration timeline and data residency.

records.title: Field Study: Denver General Hospital
records.content: Conducted contextual inquiry in emergency department over two days. Observed six shift changes and handoff procedures. Critical finding: need for specialized handoff documentation templates in high-acuity settings.

records.title: Design Ops Improvement Initiative
records.content: Streamlined research participant incentive distribution process. New digital template and approval workflow reduces legal review time by three business days. Rolling out to all teams August 12.

records.title: Cross-functional Alignment: Sales Strategy
records.content: Shared detailed insights on enterprise buyer personas with sales leadership. Sales team requesting additional competitive analysis data regarding Epic and Cerner patient portal offerings for RFP responses.

records.title: Competitive Analysis: Epic vs Cerner Portals
records.content: Deep dive into competitor patient portal feature sets. Identified significant gap in our care team messaging functionality compared to Epic's latest release. Recommended priority escalation for Q4 roadmap.

records.title: Fall Strategy Session
records.content: Leadership offsite planning for 2025 roadmap. Customer Insights team proposed AI-assisted qualitative analysis pilot program. Budget request submitted for NVivo licensing and training.

records.title: 1:1 with Grace Lin
records.content: Check-in regarding intern mentorship responsibilities. Grace demonstrating strong coaching capabilities and technical leadership. Discussed potential promotion to Senior Researcher timeline for Q1 2025.

records.title: Conference Debrief: UX Healthcare Summit
records.content: Team shared learnings from Nashville conference. Key industry trend identified: ambient clinical intelligence for automated documentation. Evaluating potential partnerships with voice AI vendors.

records.title: Q4 Planning and OKR Finalization
records.content: Finalized Q4 objectives and key results. Primary focus areas: achieve full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, improve provider satisfaction metrics by 12%, and launch medication adherence pilot study.
